title: The Horizon of Devil's Throat
author: Xanthe Kavanagh
blurb: Ansel Okafor, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the dry season ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
